alt.en: Reddish-brown narrow-plank wooden deck beside a mosaic-tiled pool, with bamboo plants along the back edge

caption.tr: Havuz çevresine döşenen deck zemin. Dar tahtalar boyuna sıralanmış, havuz kenarına kadar uzanıyor.
caption.en: A deck laid around a pool. Narrow boards run lengthwise and extend right up to the pool edge.
